```{r summarise-ecosystem-level-metrics}

# --- SUMMARISE ECOSYSTEM-LEVEL METRICS --- #

ds_ecosystems = ds_individuals %>%
  
  #Summarise for each species their bioarea and nr of individuals
  
  group_by_at(vars(time_point:volume_disturbed_across_sizes,
                   species)) %>%
  summarise(bioarea_mm2_per_ml = sum(bioarea_mm2_per_frame_per_ml),
            indiv_per_ml = sum(N_frames) / total_frames) %>% 
  
  # Go from long to wide format
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = species,
              values_from = c(bioarea_mm2_per_ml, 
                              indiv_per_ml)) %>% 
  
  # Rename the resulting columns for clarity
  
  rename(Ble_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Ble,
         Cep_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Cep,
         Col_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Col,
         Tet_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Tet,
         Eug_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Eug,
         Eup_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Eup,
         Lox_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Lox,
         Pau_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Pau,
         Pca_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Pca,
         Spi_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Spi,
         Spi_te_indiv_per_ml = indiv_per_ml_Spi_te,
         Ble_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Ble,
         Col_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Col,
         Cep_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Cep,
         Eug_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Eug,
         Eup_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Eup,
         Lox_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Lox,
         Pau_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Pau,
         Pca_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Pca,
         Spi_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Spi,
         Spi_te_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Spi_te,
         Tet_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml_Tet) %>%
  
  # Replace the NAs of species with 0 
  
  mutate(across(all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml), 
                ~ replace_na(., 0)),
         across(all_of(protist_species_indiv_per_ml), 
                ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  
  # Bind the rows which contain different protist species for the same 
  # ecosystem ID and time point
  
  group_by_at(vars(time_point:volume_disturbed_across_sizes)) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml), 
                   .fns = ~mean(.), 
                   .names = "{.col}"),
            across(.cols = all_of(protist_species_indiv_per_ml), 
                   .fns = ~mean(.), 
                   .names = "{.col}")) %>% 
  
  # Calculate ecosystem-level metrics
  
  mutate(
    
    # Calculate bioarea and individuals of ecosystems
    
    indiv_per_ml = sum(across(all_of(protist_species_indiv_per_ml))),
    bioarea_mm2_per_ml = sum(across(all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml))),
    log10_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = log10(bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
    ln_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = log(bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
    sqrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = sqrt(bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
    cbrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = bioarea_mm2_per_ml^(1/3),
    bioarea_tot_mm2 = bioarea_mm2_per_ml * ecosystem_size_ml,
    
    # Calculate biodiversity of ecosystems
    
    species_richness = specnumber(across(all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml))),
    shannon = diversity(across(all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml)),
                        index = "shannon"),
    simpson = diversity(across(all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml)),
                        index = "simpson"),
    evenness_pielou = shannon / log(species_richness),
    
    # Adjust Shannon and Simpson index to be undefined when the whole community
    # has crashed
    
    shannon = ifelse(species_richness == 0,
                     yes = NA,
                     no = shannon),
    simpson = ifelse(species_richness == 0,
                     yes = NA,
                     no = simpson),
    
    # Calculate species dominance based on biomass
    
    across(all_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml), 
           ~ (.x / bioarea_mm2_per_ml) * 100, 
           .names = "{.col}_dominance")) %>%
  
  # Ungroup to ... 
  
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Select relevant columns for final output.
  
  select(time_point,
         day,
         metaecosystem_ID,
         ecosystem_ID,
         trophic_type,
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         connection,
         volume_disturbed_across_sizes,
         bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         log10_bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         ln_bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         sqrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         cbrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         bioarea_tot_mm2,
         indiv_per_ml,
         species_richness,
         shannon,
         simpson,
         evenness_pielou,
         any_of(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml),
         any_of(protist_species_dominance))
```

```{r add-crashed-ecosystems-rows}

# --- ADD ROWS THAT CRASHED AS BIOMASS (AND NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS) AS ZERO AND THE REST AS NA --- #

for(ecosystem_ID_i in 1:max(ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_ID)){
  for(time_point_i in 0:max(ds_ecosystems$time_point)){
    
    # Check if the row is empty
    
    empty_row = ds_ecosystems %>%
      filter(ecosystem_ID == ecosystem_ID_i,
             time_point == time_point_i) %>%
      pull(bioarea_mm2_per_ml) %>%
      { length(.) == 0 }
    
    # If the row is empty then set the biomass and individuals to zero and the rest as NA
    
    if(empty_row == TRUE){
      
      ds_ecosystems = ds_ecosystems %>%
        add_row(time_point = time_point_i,
                day = unique(ds_ecosystems$day[ds_ecosystems$time_point == time_point_i]),
                metaecosystem_ID = unique(ds_ecosystems$metaecosystem_ID[ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_ID == ecosystem_ID_i]),
                ecosystem_ID = ecosystem_ID_i,
                trophic_type = unique(ds_ecosystems$trophic_type[ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_ID == ecosystem_ID_i]),
                ecosystem_size_ml = unique(ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_size_ml[ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_ID == ecosystem_ID_i]),
                connection = unique(ds_ecosystems$connection[ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_ID == ecosystem_ID_i]),
                volume_disturbed_across_sizes = unique(ds_ecosystems$volume_disturbed_across_sizes[ds_ecosystems$ecosystem_ID == ecosystem_ID_i]),
                bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                bioarea_tot_mm2 = 0,
                indiv_per_ml = 0,
                sqrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                cbrt_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Ble_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Cep_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Col_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Eug_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Eup_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Lox_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Pau_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Pca_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Spi_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Spi_te_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0,
                Tet_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = 0)
    }
  }
} 

# Test: check number of rows

expect_equal(nrow(ds_ecosystems),
             n_ecosystems * length(time_points))
```
